reasoning_accounting: Provider output token total includes reasoning; never add reasoning twice.
missing_cache_write_accounting: Conservatively price every noncached input token as a cache write when provider does not report cache-write counts.
cost_basis: List-price estimate from provider usage, not invoice-confirmed spend.
availability: Documentation confirms Responses and function calling; account availability and exact settings remain unverified until the accounted first capability request. No silent setting/model substitution.
